review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Support our compliance with PCI-DSS, ISO 27001, and Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) requirements by implementing security controls, keeping audit evidence up to date, and helping during internal and external audits. Requirements: Experience 5+years of DevOps / SRE / Cloud Engineering experience in a production environment. Technical Skills Cloud Platforms: Hands-on with AWS (EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, EKS, ELB, Route 53, CloudWatch) and Huawei Cloud (ECS, VPC, IAM, OBS, RDS, CCE, ELB, AOM, LTS).
